input: 10 initial states, paired success difference d = 0 for all (e.g. C-F d8 task 5: 10/10 vs 10/10)
explanation: signflip_ci keeps delta iff p(N - delta D) > 0.05. At delta = 0 all totals are 0 -> p = 1. For any delta whose shifted totals exceed the 1e-12 * max(1, sum|T|) tie tolerance (|delta| > ~2.5e-13 here), all 10 totals are -delta, i.e. the same sign; the observed sum is the most extreme of the 2^10 sign patterns -> p = 2/1024 = 0.002 < 0.05 -> rejected. Bisection therefore converges to the tolerance, giving +-2.4958e-13. The sign-flip null 'shifted totals symmetric about 0' can only hold at delta = 0 for a {-1, 0, 1} difference with zeros: the zeros become -delta, so H0: theta = delta != 0 never implies symmetry. The interval is an artefact of the tie tolerance, not a statement about any estimand.

one_sided_case.input: 1 discordant state (-1), 9 concordant (e.g. C-F d8 task 7)
one_sided_case.explanation: any delta > tol makes all 10 shifted totals negative -> p = 2/1024; the upper end is pinned at 0 (+tol) although only ONE state is discordant and the exact McNemar p is 1.
